description.en: No voice: the music is the clock and everything moves with it.
description.vi: Không lời: nhạc là đồng hồ và mọi thứ chuyển động theo nó.

script.guidance: Nobody speaks. Each scene is one line short enough to read in a second — a claim, a name, a number. Write no body text at all: there is no voice to carry it and no time to read it.

draw.guidance: Bold and flat: one line of type, very large, centred or hard against one edge, over a plain ground. High contrast, one accent colour, no gradients to speak of and no small text anywhere.
motion: There is no voice, so never call nodecine.when(): it has nothing to hear and will only spread things evenly, which is the opposite of this form.
Everything is driven by the sound. Read it with nodecine.audio('music-1'); it returns null when no analysis is wired in, so guard it and fall back to a steady pulse of nodecine.duration / 4.

Use nodecine.frame(function (t) { ... }) with the bands: scale the type by 1 + bass * 0.06, push the accent's brightness with high, and let the ground breathe on level. Small numbers — the frame should pulse, not jump.
Things arrive on a beat and hold: no long eases, no drifting. A move takes under 0.2s and then the frame is still until the next one.
The scene ends on the frame it began: no fade out, the cut does the work.
